snippet.title: Dressmaker - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Become a dressmaker! The ultimate cozy crafting and dressmaking simulation game. Make custom clothes, select fabrics, arrange and cut patterns, sew garments, and create detailed outfits.

Whether you want to create stunning historical or modern fashion, decorate with buttons, bows, and lace, or run your own boutique shop.

Dressmaker gives you complete creative freedom over every step of the sewing process. Meet charming townsfolk, and fulfill their custom clothing orders to help (or sabotage!) their special events.

Play Dressmaker today on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4019220/Dressmaker/

Key Features:
-Realistic Sewing & Crafting: Design in your sketchbook, choose fabrics, cut patterns, sew pieces, and customize details.
-Full Design Freedom: Add appliqué, lace trims, buttons, and unique accessories wherever you want.
-Rich narrative and immersion: Fulfill custom orders for locals or sell off-the-rack designs.
-Cozy Simulation Gameplay: Relaxing crafting mechanics mixed with rich fashion customization.
